title: BiyaHey! curated landmark aliases
description: Hand-checked pointers from a curated inventory landmark to a specific OSM stop feature whose name is the stop's own name. No coordinates live here: publish reads them from the OSM extract, and `source` records the built feed's stops.txt line that proves the stop exists in the artifact.

osm_stop.description: OSM feature id of the named stop feature (node/<id> or way/<id>).

stop_name.description: The OSM stop feature's own name; re-checked against the extract at publish time.

source.description: 1-based line in data/build/gtfs/gtfs.zip stops.txt where this stop is carried.

note.description: Why this stop is the honest anchor for the curated landmark.
